answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, nodes register on a validation ledge by locking collateral where duplicate identities trigger cryptographic stake burning, reducing forfeited deposits to an unrecoverable ember. When an entity creates multiple identities, slashing and quadratic bonding requirements propagate a financial ripple across the cluster. This imposes superlinear cost scaling of O(k^2) on k identities, making mass entity forging mathematically non-viable.
